firstAtlasEditPrompt:
Edit this sprite atlas for background EXTRAS, preserving its exact 4-column 2-row layout, eight camera directions, same woman, same full-body silhouettes, same outfit, same walking pose scale and cell positions, and existing transparency.
Remove every facial feature in every view: NO eyes, eyebrows, nose lines, mouth, eyelashes, blush, expression. Visible faces must be completely blank flat pale-peach shapes, still with hair and a simple head outline.
Convert to very clean FLAT-COLOR Korean slice-of-life webtoon extra artwork. Each hair/skin/clothing region has ONE completely uniform solid color: hair muted medium brown, skin pale peach, cardigan pale ivory, top dusty blue, jeans muted denim blue, sneakers warm white. These are separate colors per material, NOT one monochrome person.
Remove ALL cel shadows, gradients, lighting highlights, texture, hair strands, hair shine, fabric hatching, complex wrinkles, reflected light, shading under sleeves, shoe shading. Keep just a few essential seams/folds as thin restrained lines.
Use soft light-gray or slightly darker LOCAL-COLOR linework instead of black: crisp but quiet outlines, minimal internal lines. Ordinary believable adult proportions, not a detailed anime protagonist. Transparent alpha background remains transparent with no painted backdrop, no ground shadow, no text, no labels. Exactly eight complete figures in their original separate cells.
